name: commerce-agents
description: Reference blueprint for building shopping and merchant agents with Claude. Examples in retail, commerce, telecom, and entertainment included.

name: DLSS5-Swapper
description: DLSS 5 Swapper is a powerful, easy-to-use tool for installing, managing, and restoring DLSS 5 across games and supported emulators. It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.

name: cn
description: cn is a new engine for Tailwind class merging and conflict resolution. It replaces tailwind-merge and clsx. Same APIs. Full parity. And it is 30× faster.

name: m3e-canvas
description: Sketch Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser and turn them into vibe-coding prompts.

name: reverify
description: Anti-hallucination for AI agents that read binaries. The model proposes, deterministic tools decide: every claim is VERIFIED or REFUTED against the real bytes, with evidence, and grounded facts survive context resets. MCP server + CLI.

name: DLSS5-Feeder
description: DLSS 5 neural rendering in D3D11/D12/Vulkan games that ship without any DLSS — feeds a synthetic DLAA contract (ReShade depth + motion vectors) to the DLSS 5 add-on via a private D3D12 device.

name: dlss5-visual-enhancer
description: DLSS 5 Neural Video & Image Enhancer with Frame Interpolation

name: open-seo-mcp-skills
description: Open-source SEO + GEO skills for Claude — keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks, competitor gaps, AI visibility. Runs on your real Search Console / GA4 / ads data via MCP, with DataForSEO built in. Free, MIT.

name: fable-orchestrator
